{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders as they are not conversions
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for any remaining issues
print("Shape after filtering completed orders:", sales_df.shape)
print("Value counts for customer_segment:", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("Value counts for channel:", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by segment:", conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Identify the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()
print("Highest conversion segment:", highest_conversion_segment)"}
